messages:
maya: Heads-up — noticed prod prefix/KV cache hit-rate dropped from ~94% to ~68% in us-west-2 around midnight. Any pointers on where to start digging?
liam: Which dashboard are you looking at? there are separate per-model and aggregated views.
maya: I was on the 'kv-prefix-cache' Grafana tile on the infra overview but curious about logs/traces for specific keys.
liam: ok — start here: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/kv-prefix-cache?orgId=1  (tile: prefix_hit_rate). Check the 'by-prefix' panel.
nana: (note: I'm out in an hour but quick tip) if it's prefix-level churn, you'll see drop in 'prefix-unique-count' metric and spike in loads per prefix.
nana: Also check the TTL/eviction rate metric: `kv_cache.evictions_per_minute`. sudden spikes usually mean cache warming issue.
sam: deploy-bot shows there was a rollout at 00:12 by @sam:
```
Deploy Bot: service/kv-cache v2.17.3 -> v2.17.4 (canary -> 100%)
Started: 2025-11-14T00:12:05Z
Finished: 2025-11-14T00:18:22Z
```
liam: that aligns. v2.17.4 changed prefix hashing to reduce hotspotting — might have increased cold prefixes temporarily.
maya: how can I find request traces for a sample prefix?
liam: use the trace link with tag `kv.prefix:<prefix>` e.g. https://jaeger.redwood.internal/search?service=kv-cache&tag=kv.prefix:acct-123. For logs, Datadog query: `service:kv-cache env:prod "prefix=acct-123"`
nana: for dashboards, useful queries: 
```
# Grafana/PromQL examples
sum(rate(kv_cache.hits_total{env="prod"}[5m])) by (prefix)
sum(rate(kv_cache.requests_total{env="prod"}[5m])) by (prefix)
hit_rate = hits/requests
```
liam: recommend a quick check: compare top-100 prefixes by request volume pre- and post-deploy. If distribution shifted, warming will take time.
sam: I can run a rewarm job for the biggest 200 prefixes — will take ~6-8m. Anyone object?
maya: go for it, please add a short log link when you start.
sam: started rewarm job: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/kv-rewarm/456 (logs will stream) :rocket:
deploy-bot: Rewarm job queued by sam (job/kv-rewarm/456)
liam: alert tuning thought — current alert fires on cluster-wide hit-rate < 80% for 10m. Maybe change to evaluate both cluster and 95th-percentile-per-prefix to avoid noisy pages caused by a handful of cold prefixes.
nana: +1. Proposed alert conditions: cluster hit-rate < 80% for 15m OR p95(prefix_hit_rate) < 60% for 10m. That catches regressions but reduces noise.
maya: can someone file a quick PR to update the alert rule? small description and rollback plan.
liam: I'll open PR against observability/alerts — will link it here.
sam: logs show rewarm warmed ~180 prefixes so far, hit-rate improving on the dashboard.
maya: great — can you post a screenshot or link when it stabilizes >90%?
sam: posting update in 10m.
liam: also capturing this as an incident note — adding to postmortem if we need a follow-up on hashing rollout strategy.
maya: thanks all. ping me if the PR needs an owner or if the rewarm uncovers anything else. :thumbsup:
